## Purpose and Entry Points
Context Mode is a local Node.js/Bun context-management system for AI coding clients. It exposes MCP sandbox, indexing/search, statistics, diagnostics, upgrade, and purge tools; captures session state through client hooks; and restores concise working state after compaction or resume. Primary executable paths are `src/cli.ts`, `start.mjs`, and the MCP server in `src/server.ts`; distributable bundles are `cli.bundle.mjs` and `server.bundle.mjs`.

## CLI, MCP Server, and Tool Execution
The CLI dispatches terminal commands, hook invocations, and MCP startup. The server publishes the `ctx_*` tool surface and routes requests into execution, search, session, and lifecycle services. Sandboxed execution runs code in subprocesses and returns bounded stdout rather than raw artifacts; batching/pooling supports concurrent work.
- `src/cli.ts`
- `src/server.ts`
- `src/executor.ts`
- `src/runPool.ts`

## Cross-Client Adapter Boundary
Adapters isolate client-specific configuration paths, protocol shapes, hook registration, platform detection, and installation behavior behind common adapter types. Supported clients include Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot variants, OpenCode/Kilo, Pi/OMP, OpenClaw, Kimi, Kiro, Qwen, Zed, and Antigravity. This boundary prevents core context/session semantics from depending on a particular agent runtime.
- `src/adapters/base.ts`
- `src/adapters/detect.ts`
- `src/adapters/client-map.ts`
- `src/adapters/types.ts`

## Hook Routing and Event Capture
Client hook shims normalize lifecycle events—pre-tool routing/security decisions, post-tool capture, prompt submission, compaction, session start, and stop—into shared behavior. Pre-tool routing blocks or redirects high-output/raw-data operations where host capabilities permit; post-tool and prompt hooks generate structured session events. Platform bridges and formatters adapt each host’s stdin/stdout payload and response contract.
- `hooks/run-hook.mjs`
- `hooks/pretooluse.mjs`
- `hooks/posttooluse.mjs`
- `hooks/core/routing.mjs`
- `hooks/platform-bridge.mjs`

## Session Continuity Pipeline
Structured tool and prompt events are persisted per project/session, classified, and later condensed into snapshots. On compaction or continuation, snapshots and relevant event history are reconstructed into a session directive rather than replaying raw transcripts. Analytics/pricing derive usage, cost, and savings reports from this same persisted state.
- `src/session/db.ts`
- `src/session/event-emit.ts`
- `src/session/extract.ts`
- `src/session/snapshot.ts`
- `src/session/analytics.ts`

## Local Knowledge Store and Retrieval
The knowledge subsystem indexes local content and fetched pages into project-scoped SQLite FTS5 stores. Unified retrieval combines porter and trigram search, applies ranking/reranking and snippets, and limits repeated searches with a flood guard. URL fetches use a TTL cache; raw fetched content stays local while searches return selected excerpts.
- `src/store.ts`
- `src/search/unified.ts`
- `src/search/auto-memory.ts`
- `src/fetch-cache.ts`

## Runtime, Storage, and Security
The runtime selects Bun SQLite, Node `node:sqlite`, or `better-sqlite3`; storage roots are adapter/project-aware. Security applies Claude-style allow/deny policies to sandbox commands, constrains file processing to project boundaries, and hardens network fetch targets. Native/plugin integrations run in-process where supported, notably OpenCode/Kilo, Pi/OMP, and OpenClaw.
- `src/runtime.ts`
- `src/db-base.ts`
- `src/security.ts`
- `src/store-directory.ts`
- `src/adapters/openclaw/plugin.ts`

## Distribution and Integrations
Client-specific installable bundles, rules, skills, and hook manifests live under `configs/` and plugin directories. OpenClaw has a dedicated gateway plugin, while Pi ships an extension. The optional static `web/` content is informational/dashboard-facing, not the product’s primary runtime; all context data processing and SQLite persistence remain local.
- `configs/`
- `.openclaw-plugin/index.ts`
- `.pi/extensions/context-mode/index.ts`
- `web/worker.js`
